scope: Preserved the current 1054 gameplay inventory paths plus its frozen inventory (1055 baseline paths), extended only by staged roster/reference checkpoint prefixes and explicitly named updates.
hash_algorithm: Git blob SHA-1: SHA1("blob " + canonical byte length + NUL + canonical bytes); saved model SHA-256 is supplemental
verification_limits: Ten actual model files and saved hashes; nine static and unrigged, Pip has 13 mechanical joints and six clips. Visual candidates are unapproved and not perfect. Binary/hash and client continuity checks do not constitute full visual, animation, rig or game integration approval.
